hooks.command: echo '[ai-maestro-maintainer-agent] Guardian Mode active. The patrol skill auto-baselines if the snapshot is missing; to refresh manually, invoke maintainer-guardian in baseline mode. The skill is idempotent — re-running just refreshes the baseline at $AGENT_DIR/.aimaestro/state/guardian-baseline.json. Baseline covers T1-T6 threat detection (T1 workflow scanners, T2 stale SHA pins, T3 branch-rule drift, T4 protected-path activity, T5 secret-leak markers, T6 package-manager safety-config drift). The maintainer is the guardian of the repo, not a reactive issue-fixer. A resume is a wake: drain ALL THREE inbounds FIRST and act on any mandate before other work — a mandate is a work order, not a banner. (1) AMP: amp-inbox, then amp-read per message. (2) Direct session messages from peer sessions (SendMessage / ListAgents) — these NEVER appear in amp-inbox. (3) GitHub issue and PR threads whose last comment is not yours — GitHub cannot notify you, so nothing arrives unless you look. Draining one channel and reporting the inbox clear silently drops the other two. See the Inbound discipline bullet in the persona for the commands and the degrade rules. FROZEN CLI ONLY (IRON RULE): every ai-maestro interaction goes through the frozen scripts (amp-*, aimaestro-*.sh, aid-*) — NEVER the server /api/* directly, not even as a fallback when a script is missing; degrade explicitly instead. Stated here because a hook runs with NO skill loaded, so no skill can instruct it. (gh and package-registry APIs are not covered — keep them.)'
